One Scan, Many States

Tailored For Your Sector

Understand Your Line Without the Downtime

Realtime intelligence of your manufacturing structure, services, clearances, and floor levels. Not what the layout drawing says was there a decade ago. We scan the plant while it runs, then give you a model you can test-fit equipment into before it ships.

  • Equipment fit and clearance checks
  • Conveyor and work cell layouts
  • Floor flatness and slab levels
  • Structural steel verification
  • Crane and access envelopes
  • Line relocation and expansion

Clearer Diagrams For Complex Structures

Our scanning captures every duct, hanger and pipe run exactly where it sits. Evaluate new services against measured space, and spot surface issues during coordination rather than during install.

  • Duct and pipe route verification
  • Plant room and riser surveys
  • New services clash detection
  • Ceiling void and plenum capture
  • Equipment replacement access routes

Better Design Through Measured Reality

Forgo the liability of inherited drawings or the disconnect through design to implementation. Whether a new build, renovation, adaptive reuse or additions we provide a foundational survey that leads to better, quality design.

  • Existing conditions surveys
  • Revit and CAD as-built models
  • Facade and elevation capture
  • Adaptive reuse and heritage work
  • Plans, sections and ceiling plans
  • Coordination sets for consultants
